item.title: Megan Moroney’s Schottenstein Center Setlist: Every Song from Opening Night Of Her ‘Cloud 9’ Tour in Columbus, Ohio
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and updates from the world of music. I'm your host, [Name], and today we're talking about the rising star of country music, Megan Moroney.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Megan Moroney has been making waves in the country music scene since releasing her debut album three years ago. With hits like "Tennessee Orange," "Am I Okay," and "Beautiful Things," she's quickly become one of the most popular women in country music.
[Music transitions to a gentle, country-inspired tune]
Host: Her latest studio album, Cloud 9, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 all-genre albums chart, making her the first country artist to reach the top spot since 2024. And with nine nominations for the 2026 Academy of Country Music Awards, she's definitely making a statement.
[Music picks up pace]
Host: But that's not all - Megan Moroney just kicked off her first arena headlining tour with a sold-out show at the Schottenstein Center in Columbus, Ohio. The energetic performance featured a range of songs from her albums, including 15 tracks from Cloud 9.
[Music transitions to a lively, upbeat tune]
Host: The crowd was treated to a surprise song slot, where Megan performed "Hair Salon," a fan favorite from her 2022 EP, Pistol Made of Roses. And with her signature style, she rocked pink costumes, including a sparkly short onesie and a delicate sheer gown.
[Music slows down]
Host: The tour is just getting started, with upcoming shows in Indianapolis, Chicago, and Nashville, before heading to Europe. If you're a fan of Megan Moroney, be sure to catch her live - it's going to be an unforgettable experience.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be back with more updates and news from the world of music. Until next time, goodbye!
